p0.descriptionHtml:
Light above, a pearl below. Each earring is a small circle of channel set baguette cut clear cubic zirconia, with a round white pearl hanging just beneath it so it moves as you turn. Gold tone metal frames both. The shape is classic enough for a wedding function and quiet enough for dinner.

STYLING TIP: Wear them with your hair up so the pearl swings freely.

Details

  • Top: Circle of channel set baguette cut clear cubic zirconia
  • Drop: One round white pearl
  • Sold as: One pair
  • Plating: PVD 18K gold coating, anti-tarnish
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it in its pouch so pieces do not scratch each other.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

p1.descriptionHtml:
A huggie with corners. Each hoop is squared off, four straight sides joined by softly rounded corners, in polished gold tone metal that sits close to the lobe, with four tiny white pearls set along its sides, two on each side. The shape is small and neat, so it reads modern without being loud.

STYLING TIP: Stack them with a round huggie in the next piercing to play the shapes off each other.

Details

  • Shape: Square with softly rounded corners
  • Finish: Polished
  • Pearls: Four tiny round white pearls on each hoop, two on each side
  • Fitting: Huggie
  • Sold as: One pair
  • Plating: PVD 18K gold coating, anti-tarnish
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

STYLING TIP: Wear them with a crisp collar or a saree blouse for an easy polished finish.

Each stud is a gentle curve of coloured stones in silver tone metal: a purple princess cut, a pink baguette, a yellow emerald cut at the centre, then purple and pink again, with six tiny round white pearls tucked into the gaps. Playful and bright, and still delicate on the ear.

STYLING TIP: Let them be the colour in an otherwise neutral outfit.

STYLING TIP: Wear them with an ivory or white outfit so the green reads clearly.

p6.descriptionHtml:
A butterfly, twice over. A solid four-wing butterfly in warm gold tone metal, its wings filled edge to edge with dense micro pavé of pale violet lilac stones in crisp bezels and a plain body bar between them, sits over an openwork frame whose larger butterfly outline is traced in tiny round clear stones. The shank is slim and plain, so the front does all the talking.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone on the middle finger as the one statement piece.

Details

  • Front: Four-wing butterfly in lilac micro pavé over an openwork butterfly frame of clear stones

  • Plating: PVD 18K gold coating, anti-tarnish

Rigid, polished and full of light. This bangle is built from small oval gold tone plates laid in staggered rows like brickwork, set in one firm band about 10mm wide that holds its round shape on the wrist. It wears like a classic watch strap without the watch.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone on the wrist bone, or beside a fine chain bracelet for contrast.

Details

  • Type: Rigid bangle that holds its shape; it does not flex
  • Width: Approximately 10mm
  • Construction: Small oval plates in staggered rows, like a watch strap
  • Plating: PVD 18K gold coating, anti-tarnish
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

A watch strap that keeps its shape. A rigid bangle in polished gold tone, about 10mm wide, its outer face laid with small rounded oval links in staggered rows, like the links of a watch strap. It holds its round shape on the wrist like a kada, and every link catches the light.

STYLING TIP: Wear it where a watch would sit, with the Watch Link Ring on the same hand, or stack it with a fine chain bracelet for contrast.

Details

  • Type: Rigid bangle that holds its shape; it does not flex
  • Width: Approximately 10mm
  • Links: Small rounded oval links, approximately 4mm long, in staggered rows like a watch strap

p9.descriptionHtml:
One row of light, wound twice. A coil cuff of clear marquise cut stones standing upright side by side, each in its own gold claw cup, wound twice round the wrist and finished with a small polished ball at each end. From the front it reads as two rows of light; across the back, the gold backs of the cups.

STYLING TIP: Let it be the only bracelet, with a bare neckline and hair pulled back.

Details

  • Style: Open coil cuff that wraps the wrist twice
  • Stones: Clear marquise cut cubic zirconia, approximately 7mm each, set upright side by side
  • Width: Approximately 14mm across the two turns
  • Ends: A small polished ball at each end
  • Plating: PVD 18K gold coating, anti-tarnish
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

Care

p10.descriptionHtml:
Square by square. A slim gold bangle built from a row of square tiles, about 4mm each, alternating plain polished gold with a round clear stone framed in a square bezel. Clean and graphic, it stacks easily.

STYLING TIP: Stack it with a fine chain bracelet so the square line has something soft beside it.

Details

  • Style: Slim rigid bangle
  • Pattern: Square tiles, approximately 4mm, alternating plain polished gold with a round clear stone in a square bezel

p11.descriptionHtml:
One long line, finished with a pearl. This lariat runs a fine 1.5mm gold snake chain through an open oval ring of about 20mm that holds a small round white shell pearl of about 6mm, with a large baroque shell pearl of about 15mm falling at the end. The slider lets you set how low the drop sits. Wear it long over a plain kurta for evenings out.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with a deep neckline so the baroque pearl falls clear of the fabric.

Details

  • Chain: Fine snake chain, 1.5mm
  • Feature: Open oval gold ring, approximately 20mm across
  • Pearl: Small round white shell pearl, approximately 6mm, held in the ring
  • Drop: Large white baroque shell pearl, approximately 15mm
  • Style: Slider lariat with an adjustable drop
  • Plating: PVD 18K gold coating, anti-tarnish
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

p12.descriptionHtml:
Two metals, but only just. The strand is built entirely from polished silver tone steel beads of about 6mm, mirror bright and strung in short runs joined by fine silver links, so the whole bracelet reads cool and quiet. The only warmth comes at the front, where a gold toggle bar and ring close it and a puffed gold heart of about 15mm hangs from the ring. Wear it on the days you want silver with one small gold note.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with a silver tone watch so the gold heart stays the only warm thing on the wrist.

Details

  • Beads: Polished silver tone steel spheres, approximately 6mm each
  • Bead finish: Mirror polished, not matte and not pearl
  • Links: Short runs of fine silver tone round links between the bead sections
  • Closure: Gold tone toggle bar and ring at the front
  • Charm: One puffed gold tone heart, approximately 15mm
  • Plating: Polished steel strand with a PVD 18K gold coated clasp and charm, anti-tarnish
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

p13.descriptionHtml:
The same unbroken line, cut to the wrist. Oval cut clear cubic zirconia are set on their sides, each stone turned so its long axis runs across the row, held at either flank by a slim gold claw and linked straight into the next with no chain between them. The stones sit close enough to touch. It lies flat rather than rolling, so the row stays facing up through the day, and closes on a flat rectangular box clasp.

STYLING TIP: Wear it on its own wrist, or stacked under a watch on the other.

Details

  • Stone: Oval cut clear cubic zirconia, each stone turned so its long axis runs across the row
  • Setting: Slim gold claws gripping the flanks of every stone, linked directly to one another
  • Spacing: Stones set close, with no chain between them
  • Closure: Flat rectangular box clasp
  • Finish: Polished warm gold tone
  • Plating: PVD 18K gold coating, anti-tarnish
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

p14.descriptionHtml:
A single clover on a fine chain. One four petal clover of round clear cubic zirconia, about 9mm across, is set into a fine gold tone cable chain as its centre link, held at its two side petals so it lies flat on the wrist. Light enough to wear every day and to stack with other fine chains.

STYLING TIP: Stack it with the Clover Station Bracelet, one clover beside three.

Details

  • Clover: Approximately 9mm across, set as the centre link
  • Stone: Round clear cubic zirconia, four petals around a polished gold bead
  • Setting: Fine gold claws
  • Chain: Fine cable chain, approximately 1.5mm
  • Finish: Polished gold tone
  • Plating: PVD 18K gold coating, anti-tarnish
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

p15.descriptionHtml:
Three clovers, spaced along the wrist. Three four petal clovers of round clear cubic zirconia, each about 8.5mm across, are set into a fine gold tone cable chain about 2.5cm apart, so one sits on top of the wrist and one falls to each side. Each clover has a small polished gold bead at its centre.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with the Clover Drop Earrings, or stack it with the Clover Chain Bracelet.

Details

  • Clovers: Three, approximately 8.5mm across, about 2.5cm apart
  • Stone: Round clear cubic zirconia, four petals around a polished gold bead

p16.descriptionHtml:
Two fine chains, two open hearts. Two strands joined at each end: a fine gold tone curb chain carrying two small polished beads, and beneath it a fine cable chain with two open heart outlines, each about 9mm wide, and a single bead between them. No stones, just polished gold tone that layers by itself.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone; the two strands already do the stacking.

Details

  • Strands: Two, joined at both ends
  • Upper strand: Fine curb chain with two polished gold beads
  • Lower strand: Fine cable chain with two open hearts, approximately 9mm wide, and one bead
  • Beads: Approximately 4mm
  • Stones: None
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

p17.descriptionHtml:
Small hearts, gathered where they show. This necklace is built from fine gold paperclip links, with the row of small heart shaped clear cubic zirconia stations grouped through the front centre section and plain chain running along both sides. The PVD coating is finished in 18k gold tone over surgical stainless steel, so it holds up to daily wear. Wear it on its own, or layer it under a longer chain.

STYLING TIP: Layer it with a longer pendant chain so the heart stations stay visible above it.

Details

  • Chain: Fine gold paperclip links
  • Stone: Small heart shaped clear cubic zirconia stations
  • Placement: Stations grouped through the front centre section, with plain paperclip chain along both sides
  • Finish: Tarnish resistant PVD gold coating
  • Plating: PVD 18K gold coating, anti-tarnish
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

p18.descriptionHtml:
The same pearls, taken up to the collarbone. Flat baroque shell pearls in gently varying sizes, each with its own ripple and lustre, are strung with small gold tone beads between them so the strand sits soft rather than stiff. The gold toggle is worn at the front of the throat instead of hidden at the back, and one larger pearl hangs from the bar, so the closure becomes the centrepiece.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with an open neckline and let the toggle sit dead centre.

Details

  • Pearls: Flat baroque shell pearls, natural variation in shape, size and lustre
  • Spacers: Small round gold tone beads between each pearl
  • Drop: One larger baroque pearl hanging from the toggle bar
  • Closure: Gold tone toggle clasp, T bar through ring, worn at the front
  • Finish: Polished warm gold tone
  • Plating: PVD 18K gold coating on the findings, anti-tarnish
  • Material: Shell pearl with surgical stainless steel findings
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

Care

Pearls are softer than metal and do not like chemicals. Put it on after perfume, moisturiser and hairspray, keep it out of the shower, the pool and the sea, and wipe it with a soft dry cloth after wearing. Store it flat in its pouch, away from anything that could scratch the surface.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

p19.descriptionHtml:
One line, and nothing interrupting it. This necklace sets oval cut clear cubic zirconia on their sides, each stone turned so its long axis runs across the row rather than along it, held at either flank by a slim gold claw and linked straight into the next. The stones sit close enough to touch, so the row reads as one continuous band of light rather than a series of separate points. It closes with a flat rectangular box clasp that sits flush at the back of the neck.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone with an open collar and let the row do the work.

Details

  • Stone: Oval cut clear cubic zirconia, each stone turned so its long axis runs across the row
  • Setting: Slim gold claws gripping the flanks of every stone, linked directly to one another
  • Spacing: Stones set close, with no chain between them
  • Closure: Flat rectangular box clasp

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

p20.descriptionHtml:
A plain line above, pearl hearts below. Two strands, layered for you: a fine round gold tone snake chain at the base of the neck and, a little lower, a fine cable chain stationed with white heart shaped pearls, each pointing down, between small polished gold beads. Each heart is about 7mm.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with an open neckline so both strands show.

Details

  • Strands: Two, a snake chain above a pearl station chain
  • Pearls: White heart shaped pearls, approximately 7mm, each pointing down
  • Beads: Small polished gold beads, approximately 3mm, between the pearls
  • Upper strand: Fine round snake chain
  • Finish: Polished gold tone
  • Plating: PVD 18K gold coating, anti-tarnish
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.
